verdict.rationale: Elicit runs AI operations across whole sets of papers. Data-extraction columns apply to every paper in a table, automated screening and full-text screening cover the review corpus, chat can summarize multiple papers along set dimensions, and tags can be applied to a batch of newly uploaded papers. General selection-based bulk management is not evidenced, and editing paper metadata is documented per row. Missing for 10: bulk edit/delete/move of selected library items, bulk actions via API or MCP, documented scale limits, independent hands-on corroboration of batch operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
